title.rendered: Recognition of Sabourg’s sovereignty by Cameroon.

content.rendered:
On October 27, 2025, H.E. Paul Biya was re-elected president of Cameroon.
During the 4vision news broadcast on October 31 at 8 p.m., congratulatory letters from Sabourg and three other states—Spain, Belgium, and Russia—were read publicly.
This further confirms Sabourg’s credibility in equatorial Africa, considered
This further confirms Sabourg’s credibility in equatorial Africa, considered
by the Republic of Cameroon to be a sovereign state on a par with Spain, Belgium, and Russia.
